post.summary: Issue a single-use WebAuthn challenge ticket for a session
post.description:
**Protocols:** Linked Device API

**Required scope:** `sessions:manage`

Your team must have direct-pairing access for the target Number. Use [QuickLink](/integrations/quicklink) for standard connections. Binds a WhatsApp-originated passkey challenge to one session with a short TTL. The extension runs the ceremony and the assertion comes back to the redeem endpoint.

post.summary: Redeem a passkey ticket with the ceremony assertion
post.description:
**Protocols:** Linked Device API

**Required scope:** `sessions:manage`

The complete HTTP body is limited to 1048576 UTF-8 bytes before JSON parsing. Credential IDs allow at most 1023 decoded bytes; user handles allow 64. Opaque assertion fields share the body budget without independent small caps. Your team must have direct-pairing access for the target Number. Single-use: verifies the assertion is bound to the ticket challenge, forwards it to the session runner, and consumes the ticket once acknowledged.

request_id.description: Matches the X-Request-Id response header. Include it when you contact support.

request_log_url.description: Console page that shows this request. Returned only to organization and project credentials whose request was logged.

data.description: Always null for a failed request.

challengeB64Url.description: Optional expected challenge. If supplied it must match the current runner snapshot; it never supplies ceremony options.

userVerification.description: Ignored. The current runner determines user verification.

ttlSeconds.description: Requested ticket lifetime, independent of the WebAuthn timeout. Defaults to 300 seconds and is clamped to 255–300 seconds, then capped by the current challenge deadline. No new ticket is issued with less than 255 seconds remaining. The budget includes one minute to enter the ticket, two 10-second verification calls, 30 seconds for explicit consent, 15 seconds for popup startup, a five-second minimum prompt, and a 120-second post-prompt reserve for final verification, one minute to copy the assertion, both direct server RPCs, access checks and transit. A short remaining window is withheld from new callers without retiring an advertised live ticket. Renewal waits for expiry; an explicitly shorter lifetime constraint may retire an unreserved ticket. In-flight forwarding blocks replacement. Current runner authority is revalidated throughout.

timeoutMs.description: Ignored. The current runner determines ceremony timeout.
